proposed_core_edits.reason: Declares the conflict-graph and WRI-law definitions used to prove compatibility and independence of the selected focal set.

proposed.statement: For every rule \(\ell\), the RDIM error is the \(2n\)-dimensional random linear form \(\widehat\tau_{\ell}-\tau=a_{\ell}^{\mathsf T}\theta\), and its exact design-based mean squared error is \(\mathbb E_{\ell}[(\widehat\tau_{\ell}-\tau)^2]=\theta^{\mathsf T}Q_{\ell}\theta\).
proposed.justification: This exact quadratic object retains selection bias, random denominators, and randomization variance in one design-computable matrix.
proposed.gap: Shi et al. bound RDIM MSE by a surrogate; they do not state the exact endpoint quadratic risk.
proposed.consumer: The matrix is the loss input required to choose a prespecified WRI rule for a rural-China insurance-information follow-up.

proposed_core_edits.reason: Declares the WRI order law used by the independent-priority integral coupling in the forest proof.

proposed.statement: If \(C_G\) is a forest, the three-state forest-message construction computes every \(F_{\ell,A}\) exactly and hence every \(Q_{\ell}\) in \(L\operatorname{poly}(n,b)\) bit operations, uniformly over all \(|A|\le2\).
proposed.justification: The forest theorem is a nontrivial solved rung and a falsifiable base case for any separator invariant.
proposed.gap: Pippenger and Krivelevich et al. study occupancy or expected size on trees, not the complete weighted marked count law needed for exact causal risk.
proposed.consumer: Village conflict forests receive an exact design selector even if the general fixed-parameter question is negative.

proposed_core_edits.reason: Adds the spectral, Slater-duality, and real-algebraic sample-point leaves used by the proof to the declared dependency spine.

proposed.statement: For binary-encoded rational inputs \(B>0\), \(H\succ0\), and \(Q_1,\ldots,Q_L\succeq0\), finite-dimensional semidefinite duality gives optimizers attaining \(V^{\star}=B^2t^{\star}=B^2s^{\star}\) at \((q^{\star},t^{\star})\) and \((X^{\star},s^{\star})\), including zero coordinates of \(q^{\star}\) and repeated leading generalized eigenspaces. If \(H^{-1/2}X^{\star}H^{-1/2}=\sum_{j=1}^{r}\lambda_j u_ju_j^{\mathsf T}\), then \(\nu^{\star}=\sum_{j=1}^{r}\lambda_j\delta_{BH^{1/2}u_j}\), with \(r\le2n\), is least favourable, and \(\operatorname{tr}(Q_{\ell}X^{\star})=s^{\star}\) whenever \(q_{\ell}^{\star}>0\). In the exact Turing model of the algebraic-certificate encoding, generic real quantifier elimination returns such real-algebraic optimizers in at most \((\Lambda Ln)^{2^{O(L+n^2)}}\) bit operations. Any rational feasible primal--dual pair certifies gap \(B^2(t-s)\).
proposed.justification: This is a standard finite-SDP consequence of having exact rational risk matrices; it supplies the decision certificate but is not an independent novelty claim.
proposed.gap: Duarte, Sagnol, and Wong provide the generic minimax semidefinite-design machinery; the proposition records its exact encoding and endpoint interpretation for the WRI library without claiming a new duality theorem.
proposed.consumer: It converts any exact marked-moment oracle into a verifiable rule mixture before the rural-China insurance-information follow-up.

proposed_core_edits.reason: Declares the exact loading-norm bound and the matrix Bernstein theorem used in the simultaneous concentration proof.

proposed.statement: Let \(A_n^2=2-2/n\). If \(0<\varepsilon\le A_n^2\) and \(N\ge(8/3)A_n^4\varepsilon^{-2}\log(4nL/\delta)\), then \(\Pr\{\max_{1\le\ell\le L}\|\widehat Q_{\ell}-Q_{\ell}\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le\varepsilon\}\ge1-\delta\). On this event, \(V_{-}\le V^{\star}\le V_{+}\), the returned mixture satisfies \(\sup_{\vartheta\in\Theta_G(B)}\vartheta^{\mathsf T}Q(q_{+})\vartheta\le V_{+}\), and \(V_{+}-V_{-}\le2B^2\varepsilon\|H\|_{\mathrm{op}}=2B^2\varepsilon\).
proposed.justification: This supplies a finite-sample fallback for arbitrary graphs while preserving the spectral loss relevant to the selected mixture.
proposed.gap: Ugander and Yin resample exposure probabilities, and Tropp controls matrix sums; no located result gives a simultaneous exact-RDIM rule-matrix region with a downstream minimax-risk gap.
proposed.consumer: The experimenter receives a risk certificate even when the observed village conflict graph has large treewidth.

proposed_core_edits.reason: Declares the conflict-graph definition used to infer that all closed exposure neighborhoods are singleton sets.

proposed.statement: If \(C_G\) has no edges, then \(S_{\ell}=V\) for every \(\ell\) and every priority order, all \(Q_{\ell}\) coincide, every mixture has the same risk, and \(\widehat\tau_{\ell}\) is the usual balanced complete-randomization difference in means for the finite-population total effect.
proposed.justification: The reduction verifies that the proposed objects collapse to the classical no-interference design.
proposed.gap: This is a required sanity reduction rather than an independent novelty claim.
proposed.consumer: It lets practitioners interpret the method as a network-aware extension of standard complete randomization.

open_obligations.what_is_open: Neither required branch is presently proved: there is no separator-message representation with size and exact-operation cost \(2^{O(w\log(w+1))}\operatorname{poly}(n,b)\), and there is no parameter-preserving reduction proving \(\#\mathrm{W[1]}\)-hardness or \(\mathrm{W[1]}\)-hardness for a required tagged coefficient.
open_obligations.obstruction: Conditioning at a separator does not eliminate dependence on the numerical bag priorities.  With \(r\le w+1\) active priorities and total weight \(W\le nb\), a direct order-chamber message is a multivariate polynomial with as many as \(\binom{W+r}{r}\) coefficient positions per count and discrete state.  Join multiplies two such conditional messages and forget integrates them chamberwise.  The frozen handle supplies no proved circuit normalization or equivalence relation that keeps these operations fixed-parameter in \(w\); conversely, the large dense representation is not a lower bound against all compressed representations.
open_obligations.attempted: The local greedy certificate was converted into relative bag orders, selected/unselected labels, higher-priority blocking bits, tag constraints, and count convolution.  Introduce-edge and forget conditions are local, and conditional independence gives the intended join product.  The forest recurrence closes this program for one-vertex separators.  For larger bags, dense coefficient storage retains an \((nb)^{O(w)}\) factor, while a factorized arithmetic-circuit representation has no proved canonical form closed under both join and exact integration.  The known cover-graph linear-extension hardness warning was considered, but no reduction to this weighted greedy tagged reciprocal-count oracle was obtained.
